_meta.purpose: Source registry for every reference-backed statement shown in RE:MAT AI.
_meta.honesty_note: These are curated POINTERS to public rules and authorities. Rule titles and the issuing authority were confirmed by web search on 2026-10-19. Clause-level wording was NOT verified by this project. Always confirm on the official site before relying on a statement. No facility directory is bundled: the app never claims that a specific facility exists, is licensed, or accepts a given waste.

SRC_EWASTE_RULES_2022.title: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022
SRC_EWASTE_RULES_2022.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), India
SRC_EWASTE_RULES_2022.find_at: Search 'E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022' on the MoEFCC or CPCB website.
SRC_EWASTE_RULES_2022.check_method: rule title and issuing authority confirmed via web search; clauses not verified
SRC_EWASTE_RULES_2022.supports: E-waste is handled through producer extended responsibility (EPR) and registered entities such as recyclers and refurbishers.

SRC_BATTERY_RULES_2022.title: Batteries (Management) Rules, 2022
SRC_BATTERY_RULES_2022.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), India
SRC_BATTERY_RULES_2022.find_at: Search 'Batteries (Management) Rules 2022' on the MoEFCC or CPCB website.
SRC_BATTERY_RULES_2022.check_method: rule title and issuing authority confirmed via web search; clauses not verified
SRC_BATTERY_RULES_2022.supports: Waste batteries fall under producer extended responsibility; they should go through producer take-back or authorized collection and recycling.

SRC_HOWM_RULES_2016.title: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
SRC_HOWM_RULES_2016.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), India
SRC_HOWM_RULES_2016.find_at: Search the rule title on the MoEFCC or CPCB website.
SRC_HOWM_RULES_2016.check_method: rule title and issuing authority confirmed via web search; clauses not verified
SRC_HOWM_RULES_2016.supports: Hazardous wastes, including used oil, must be handled by authorized parties under State Pollution Control Board authorization.

SRC_CPCB.title: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) - hazardous waste, e-waste and used oil pages
SRC_CPCB.find_at: On the CPCB site, look for hazardous waste management, e-waste and battery EPR pages and lists of registered or authorized entities.
SRC_CPCB.check_method: authority identity confirmed via web search; individual list entries not verified
SRC_CPCB.supports: National regulator that publishes guidance and registered-entity information for hazardous waste, e-waste and used oil.

SRC_SPCB.title: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the relevant state or union territory
SRC_SPCB.find_at: Search '<your state name> Pollution Control Board' and look for hazardous waste authorizations and authorized recyclers / TSDFs.
SRC_SPCB.check_method: role described in regulations summaries found via web search; no individual board site verified
SRC_SPCB.supports: The state-level body that authorizes hazardous-waste handlers and can tell you who is authorized in your area.

SRC_NPMCR_2014.title: National Policy for Management of Crop Residues (NPMCR), 2014
SRC_NPMCR_2014.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
SRC_NPMCR_2014.find_at: Search 'National Policy for Management of Crop Residues 2014' on the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare site.
SRC_NPMCR_2014.check_method: policy title and in-situ / ex-situ management approach confirmed via web search; details not verified
SRC_NPMCR_2014.supports: Crop residue management through in-situ incorporation and ex-situ uses such as fuel, pellets and composting.

SRC_LOCAL_AGRI.title: Local agriculture office or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)
SRC_LOCAL_AGRI.authority: State agriculture department / ICAR KVK network
SRC_LOCAL_AGRI.find_at: Ask the district agriculture office or the nearest KVK about residue management machinery, buyers and local burning rules.
SRC_LOCAL_AGRI.supports: Local, current information about residue buyers, machinery schemes and burning restrictions.

SRC_EMERGENCY.title: Local emergency services
SRC_EMERGENCY.authority: Local emergency services (112 is the unified emergency number in India)
SRC_EMERGENCY.check_method: general safety guidance, not a dataset lookup
SRC_EMERGENCY.supports: Immediate danger such as fire, leaks, fumes or exposure.
